description: TabMail experiment API to read calendar data until MV3 calendar API is complete.

functions.name: getCalendarEventDetails
functions.description: Gets details for a specific calendar event by ID.

parameters.name: calendar_id
parameters.description: Optional calendar ID for faster lookup. If provided, searches this calendar first.

parameters.name: recurrence_id
parameters.description: Optional start_iso of an occurrence of a repeating event, as the read tools show it; the result then says whether it is the series' first occurrence, and its original time when it was moved off it.

start.description: Start time as Unix timestamp in seconds

end.description: End time as Unix timestamp in seconds

recurrenceIdIsFirst.description: With recurrence_id: whether it names the series' first occurrence; absent when it names no single occurrence.

recurrenceIdSlot.description: With recurrence_id naming an occurrence moved off its usual time: that usual (original) time, as the read tools show a start_iso; absent otherwise.

recurrence.description: The rule in the create/edit tools' fields (freq, interval, count, until as the last day, byDay, byMonthDay, byMonth, wkst; other = parts those fields cannot express); null when the event does not repeat.

error.description: Error message if ok is false

functions.name: queryCalendarItems
functions.description: Queries events in a time range from selected calendars.

functions.name: getCalendars
functions.description: Gets a list of available calendars with their metadata.

functions.name: createCalendarEvent
functions.description: Creates a calendar event directly without opening a dialog.

check_only.description: Read the times up to the all-day end refusal and write nothing. ok: false carries the refusal.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'). When provided, naive start_iso / end_iso strings are interpreted in this zone instead of the user's local TB timezone.

functions.name: modifyCalendarEvent
functions.description: Modifies a calendar event directly without opening a dialog.

calendar_id.description: Optional calendar ID for faster lookup. If provided, searches this calendar first.

recurrence_id.description: For recurring events, the recurrence ID (start ISO of the target occurrence). Required when edit_scope is 'this_only' or 'this_and_following'.

edit_scope.description: For recurring events, which occurrences this edit applies to. 'all' (default if no recurrence_id) modifies the series. 'this_only' overrides a single occurrence (requires recurrence_id). 'this_and_following' splits the series at recurrence_id, capping the master and creating a new series with the patch applied (requires recurrence_id). When omitted, behaves as 'this_only' if recurrence_id is set, otherwise 'all'.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone identifier (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles'). When provided, naive start_iso / end_iso strings are interpreted in this zone instead of the user's local TB timezone.

add_attendees.description: Guests to add to every item the edit covers. One already listed is not added again.

remove_attendees.description: Guests to remove from every item the edit covers; an email of * removes everyone.

recurrence.description: Recurrence rule to set or update on the event.

exdates_add.description: EXDATEs to add (ISO start datetimes of occurrences).

check_only.description: Run the edit, every refusal included, up to its first write and write nothing (a split through splitRecurringEvent's check). ok: false carries the refusal; ok: true carries changes, times and resetsChangedOccurrences.

old_event_id.description: On edit_scope 'this_and_following': the series' id (now ending before the split); event_id is the new series'.

recurrence_id.description: The occurrence event_id names: on edit_scope 'this_only', the one edited (its start as written, as the read tools print its recurrence_id); on 'this_and_following', the new series' first occurrence (its start, moved when the edit moved it).

split_at.description: On edit_scope 'this_and_following': where the new series starts.

changes.description: With check_only: whether the edit changes anything (a time or value it only restates is no change).

times.description: With check_only: the times the edit changes, as the read tools print them, from the occurrence it names (or the first) to that occurrence as written; absent when it changes none.

resetsChangedOccurrences.description: With check_only: whether a new start of the series (or of the part from the split on) resets the occurrences changed on their own and brings back the excluded ones.

functions.name: splitRecurringEvent
functions.description: Split a recurring series at recurrence_id: cap the master so it ends before the occurrence recurrence_id names (its start as the read tools print it), then create a new series from that occurrence with `patch` applied. Attendee notifications fire only on the new series.

calendar_id.description: Optional calendar ID. If omitted, the bridge scans all calendars to locate the event.

recurrence_id.description: ISO8601 start datetime of the first occurrence that should belong to the NEW series.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone identifier for interpreting naive ISO timestamps.

check_only.description: Build both parts, every refusal included, up to the first write and write nothing. ok: false carries the refusal; ok: true carries changes, times and resetsChangedOccurrences.

patch.description: Fields to apply to the new series. Inherits the master's values for any field not present in patch.

add_attendees.description: Guests to add to every item the edit covers. One already listed is not added again.

remove_attendees.description: Guests to remove from every item the edit covers; an email of * removes everyone.

event_id.description: Event id of the NEW series.

old_event_id.description: Event id of the master series (now capped).

recurrence_id.description: The NEW series' first occurrence (its start_iso as the read tools print it): the occurrence event_id names.

changes.description: With check_only: whether the edit changes anything (a time or value it only restates is no change).

times.description: With check_only: the times the edit changes, as the read tools print them, from the occurrence it names (or the first) to that occurrence as written; absent when it changes none.

resetsChangedOccurrences.description: With check_only: whether a new start of the series (or of the part from the split on) resets the occurrences changed on their own and brings back the excluded ones.

calendar_id.description: Optional calendar ID for faster lookup. If provided, searches this calendar first.
